task:
Implement the "hoo" brand consistently across the UI in this React/Vite project. The app is called "HooCowork" and has a provider called "hoocode" / "HooCode". There are many hardcoded "Claude Code", "Claude", and generic references in user-facing copy that should be updated to "HooCode" or "HooCowork" or made neutral.

Read the following files and make the minimal, correct edits. Do NOT change provider registry display names for other providers (Claude, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot should keep their real names). Only change copy that refers to the app's own default/recommended experience.

Files to modify:

1. `public/manifest.json` — update `description` from "A web-based UI for Claude Code, Cursor CLI, Codex, and Gemini-CLI" to "A web-based UI for HooCode, Claude Code, Cursor CLI, Codex, and Gemini CLI"

2. `src/components/onboarding/view/subcomponents/AgentConnectionsStep.tsx` — the `hoocode` provider card has `title: 'Pi'`. Change it to `title: 'HooCode'`.

3. `src/components/task-master/view/modals/CreateTaskModal.tsx` — change "ask Claude Code directly" to "ask HooCode directly" in the h4 text.

4. `src/components/prd-editor/view/GenerateTasksModal.tsx` — change "Ask Claude Code directly" to "Ask HooCode directly" and "Claude Code in chat" to "HooCode in chat".

5. `src/components/settings/constants/constants.ts` — find the agents settings tab entry with `keywords: 'agents subagents claude code'` and change `claude code` to `hoocode`.

6. `src/i18n/locales/en/sidebar.json` — update these keys:
   - `projects.runClaudeCli`: change "Run Claude CLI" to "Run HooCode CLI"
   - `projects.fetchingProjects`: change "Fetching your Claude projects and sessions" to "Fetching your projects and sessions"

7. `src/i18n/locales/en/common.json` — update:
   - `emptyState.selectProjectDescription`: change "coding with Claude" to "coding with HooCode"
   - `projectWizard.steps.workspace.existingInfo`: change "Claude/Cursor sessions" to "HooCode/Cursor sessions"
   - `projectWizard.steps.workspace.newEmpty`: same change

8. `src/i18n/locales/en/chat.json` — update:
   - `providerSelection.instruction`: change "where Claude is running" to "where HooCode is running"
   - `providerSelection.selectedOption`: change "Claude selected option" to "HooCode selected option"
   - `providerSelection.resetAt`: keep this one as-is because it's provider-specific
   - `thinkingMode.extended.description`: change "Extended thinking gives Claude more time" to "Extended thinking gives HooCode more time"
   - `thinkingMode.regular.description`: change "Regular Claude response" to "Regular HooCode response"
   - `providerSelection.readyPrompt.claude`: change "Ready to use Claude" to "Ready to use HooCode"
   - `emptyState.startSession`: change "Start a new Claude session" to "Start a new HooCode session"
   - `emptyState.startCli`: change "Starting Claude CLI" to "Starting HooCode CLI"
   - Keep `claudeStatus` key name as-is, but if there's a "Claude" string inside its values, change to "HooCode"

9. `src/i18n/locales/en/settings.json` — update:
   - `api.description`: change "Claude/Cursor sessions" to "HooCode/Cursor sessions"
   - `agents.providers.claude.description`: change "Anthropic Claude AI assistant" to "Anthropic Claude AI assistant" (keep this one — it's accurate)
   - Actually wait, find any generic app references. The `plugins.description` says `~/.claude-code-ui/plugins/` — that's the actual folder name, keep it.
   - `permissions.claudeDescription`: change "Equivalent to --dangerously-skip-permissions flag" to keep as-is (it's provider-specific)
   - `mcp.claude`: change "Model Context Protocol servers provide additional tools and data sources to Claude" to "Model Context Protocol servers provide additional tools and data sources to HooCode" only if this is the generic/hoocode description. If there's a separate one per provider, update the hoocode one.

10. `src/i18n/locales/en/mcp.json` — update `globalDescription`: change "Claude, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini" to "HooCode, Claude, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini"

11. `src/i18n/locales/en/tasks.json` — update `parsePRD`: change "Claude Task Master" to "HooCode Task Master"

Read each file before editing. Make exact text replacements. Return a summary of all changed files and the specific text changes made.
